internal.title: Incident Summary: Accounting Service Latency and Kafka Consumer Lag
internal.body:
At 11:57 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high Kafka consumer lag in the accounting service. Diagnosis identified high p95 latency (5200 ms) and elevated CPU utilization (0.25), indicating latency issues likely due to resource constraints. The Kafka consumer lag was very high (5200 records), showing a backlog in processing messages. CPU utilization was moderately high, suggesting possible resource exhaustion contributing to the latency and backlog.

Multiple diagnosis rounds were conducted. Initial proposals for action were refused due to lack of concrete action plans or mismatches with guardrails. The incident was escalated for further investigation and resolution.

No immediate resolution was implemented during the incident timeline, and root cause confirmation is pending further analysis.

Next steps include detailed resource usage analysis and potential scaling or optimization of the accounting service to prevent recurrence.
